content.comment_body: Hello, Will [product_name] eventually be included in [product_name] software instead of relying on [product_name] software in the future?

The goal of the [product_name] framework is to bring together all [company_name] software. In my opinion, it's quite possible that [company_name] will introduce a version of [product_name] that could be integrated into the [product_name] framework. Such integration would simplify building networks consisting of [product_name] devices. However, the current [product_name] software already supports networked devices using a graphical interface. Additionally, [product_name] project files can be accessed from a network diagram if configured appropriately. There are, however, some obstacles to this transition: 1. Many individuals use [product_name] for non-industrial purposes and prefer a lightweight, standalone solution, which the [product_name] framework does not provide. 2. (Just my opinion) The [product_name] programming software is built with Java, whereas the [product_name] environment uses DotNet. These are just personal observations and unrelated to the official discussion taking place here. The main question remains – what prompted your inquiry?

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are evaluating whether [product_name] will become part of the [product_name] framework. Some appreciate the simplicity and independence of the current [product_name] software, especially for non-industrial users. Potential integration challenges include differences in software platforms (Java vs. DotNet).
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a possible future integration of [product_name] into [product_name] to simplify device management and configuration, but many still prefer a lightweight, standalone option.
